title: Negromancy | Extensive Scholarly Support Census
scope: Public index derived from the full 7 October 2026 private conceptual and scholarly audit: recovered working scholar/source list, sections 11 and 11A. The originating annotated audit and the private manuscript remain unpublished.
coverage_warning: C3/C2 denote prior project coverage, not independently validated complete reading of a writer's oeuvre. Unlisted C1-or-ungraded means lead only, not lack of scholarly merit. Every record requires independent verification, title/edition correction, full bibliography expansion, lawful access checks, exact claims, passages and scope limits.
copyright: Bibliographic metadata only; no copyrighted complete works are republished. Link to verified lawful public access or authorized provider. Do not use unauthorized scans.

definitions.C3: Higher 2026 project coverage of named work(s), not complete oeuvre or authoritative source certification
definitions.C2: Working concept/work coverage in private prior research, pending independent close reading
definitions.C1-or-ungraded: Bibliographic research lead or historic inclusion; source-by-source reading remains to be established
